purpose: Create an execution fault in which robot commands and end-effector motion can remain nominal while the manipulated object slips or is lost.
stopping_rule: For each task, stop escalating at the first severity that produces measurable object loss without directly changing robot action or EEF state.
acceptance_checks: default-off fixed-noise rollout remains exactly reproducible
all pre-onset intended actions, executed actions, and robot states match the paired normal rollout
object-slip labels are oracle_only_ fields and rejected from detector features
robot action is not modified by the object-slip injector
friction and external wrench are restored at episode end
report object-relative-to-gripper displacement and task success separately
